estimates: Every figure of a results filing's statements (results, segments, balance sheet, cash flow), read twice by two different AI models, with each figure amber when the reads differ, a check fails or the scan is poor

bar.description: R0's bar (PLAN.md R0): no wrong figure left unflagged and under 2% of figures amber; production reads filings only while the headline set meets it

baseline.description: Read A alone, with the sums the table states checked (what one AI read and arithmetic give)

metrics.description: Share of wrong digits planted in read A (one at a time) that the reader still shows without amber
Share of figures shown amber (the analyst must look at each one)
Figures of the truth file (BSE's own, where saved) shown without amber and not as printed
Share of the truth file's figures the reader shows, without amber, as BSE gives them

evaluation.regions_note: India only for now: every filing is an Indian listed company's quarterly results

development.description: R0's 30 filings, on which the prompt and the checks were worked out (in-sample): 30 filings, 7,998 figures, prompts r0, r0-first

held_out.description: Filings read after the prompt and checks were frozen: none tuned on them: 8 filings, 1,777 figures, prompts r1

held_out_high.description: The held-out filings read again at high resolution (READER_HIGH_RESOLUTION=1): 2 filings, 628 figures, prompts r1

split.why: nothing is trained; the held-out set is filings published or read after the prompt and the checks were frozen, and the development set is labelled in-sample

limitations: Two reads making the same mistake in a figure outside every sum is not seen: the planted digits test one read's misreads, and the truth file covers the quarter's headline figures of 17 filings only (ten development, seven held-out).
The development set's prompt and checks were worked out on those very filings; only the held-out set says how the reader does on new ones.
Six development filings were read by R0's first pass, the results table only; one (Yatharth Hospital) has a lite model's read A.
Indian listed companies' results only; banks, insurers and lenders are left out.

The held-out filings are eight June 2026 quarter or March 2026 year-end filings saved by hand, not a random sample; one hard scan (Larsen & Toubro's, its segment table read differently by the two models) holds most of their amber figures.
The high-resolution trial (held_out_high) has fewer filings than the card needs: the free allowance ran out on the first day.
A wrong year in every column heading is a period problem, not an amber figure: the analyst names the quarter, or the reads must agree on it.
name: Results reader

training.data: Nothing is trained: the prompts are research/reader/prompt.py and the checks research/reader/checks.py; the recorded answers are tests/fixtures/research/reader (python -m research.reader.record)

used_by: Equity research -> Coverage -> Results (POST /api/research/reads, job research.read); production reads filings only while this card's headline set meets R0's bar
